message:
vc_obj2tifxyz: fail instead of writing an all-sentinel tifxyz for normalized UVs

With default arguments, any OBJ whose UVs are normalized to [0,1] (the
format of the published segments under paths/) rasterized 0 grid points
into a 2x2 grid, then reported 'Successfully converted' and exited 0,
leaving a valid-looking output directory containing only -1 sentinels.

- exit non-zero when zero grid points were rasterized, before writing
  any output
- when the UV range looks normalized, say so and name the flags that
  make the conversion work (explicit stretch_factor / --uv-to-obj)
- fix the --help example labeled 'legacy behavior' that actually runs
  in the default UV-metric mode

Verified on real scroll data: PHercParis4 path segment 20230503225234
(normalized UVs) now fails loudly with default args and converts with
an explicit stretch factor; segment 20260602204401-5753_-7 (metric UVs,
58% valid points) is unaffected.

Fixes #1320

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <[email redacted]>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_0189NTjHVfExtaqTtNSpXYck

vc_obj2tifxyz: also refuse the degenerate 2x2 output grid

Review on #1630 found an adjacent leak: a normalized-UV mesh whose UV
layout happens to cover one grid corner rasterizes 1/4 points instead of
0/4, slips the exact-zero guard, and still writes a mostly-sentinel 2x2
tifxyz with exit 0. A 2x2 grid is the clamped minimum -- the UV range
collapsed below one output pixel -- so refuse it regardless of valid
count. Verified: reviewer's 1/4 quad now exits 1 with no output; the
0/4 case, the stretch_factor escape hatch, and the metric-UV control
behave as before.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <[email redacted]>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_0189NTjHVfExtaqTtNSpXYck

vc_obj2tifxyz: drop the flag suggestion, just fail on a degenerate grid

A 2x2 grid fails regardless, so pointing the user at --uv-to-obj or a
stretch_factor was misleading. The guard now just reports the invalid
tifxyz and exits non-zero.
